# Chamok Fish Feed (চমক ফিশ ফিড)

> Chamok Fish Feed is a fish feed brand of Best Padma Agro Feeds, based in Rajshahi, Bangladesh. It makes floating and sinking feed for carp, tilapia and pangas fish, sold in 20 kg and 25 kg bags through dealers. Tagline: কম খরচে বেশি উৎপাদনে চমক ফিড ব্যবহার করুন।

## Company

- Legal parent company: Best Padma Agro Feeds
- Founded: 2010. The Chamok brand launched in 2013; the Biotech brand launched in 2020.
- Founder and Managing Director: Md. Khairul Bashar (মো. খায়রুল বাশার)
- Head office: Chini Patti Goli, Boalia, Rajshahi, Bangladesh
- Factory: Inam Feed Mill, Dhopapara, Puthia, Rajshahi (operating since 2017)
- Phone / WhatsApp: +880 1741-973426 (https://wa.me/8801741973426)
- Email: chamokfishfeed@gmail.com
- Hours: Saturday to Thursday 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM; Friday 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM

## Products

- [Chamok Carp Grower](https://chamokfish.com/products/chamok-carp-grower): Sinking feed for carp. 24% protein (carp), 28% protein (tilapia), 6% fat, 3.5 mm pellet, 25 kg bag.
- [Chamok Floating Feed (Oil Coated)](https://chamokfish.com/products/chamok-floating-feed): Floating feed for tilapia, carp and pangas. Protein: tilapia 30%, carp 23%, pangas 28%. 5% fat, 25 kg bag.
- [Biotech Nursery / Carp Care](https://chamokfish.com/products/biotech-nursery-carp-care): Mash feed for fry and fingerlings (nursery stage). 36% protein, 7% fat, 20 kg bag.
- [Biotech Floating Grower](https://chamokfish.com/products/biotech-floating-grower): Floating grower feed. Protein: tilapia 30%, carp 25%, pangas 23%. 5% fat, 20 kg bag. Pellet 3 mm, and 4 mm for pangas.
- [Biotech Carp Grower](https://chamokfish.com/products/biotech-carp-grower): Sinking feed for carp. Protein 22% to 24% (Premium 24%, Economy 22%), 5% fat, 3.5 mm pellet, 25 kg bag.

Full product list: https://chamokfish.com/products

## Notes

- The website does not publish prices. For current prices, contact the company on WhatsApp or by phone.
- FCR (Feed Conversion Ratio) means how much feed is needed to produce 1 kg of fish growth. Lower FCR means better feed efficiency. Results depend on fish species, water quality and pond management.
